records.text: An unnamed viewer asked how often a fire captain rode a fire truck to a hospital ER to perform CPR on a corpse said to have been dead for 15 minutes, and rhetorically asked whether the hospital had no medical personnel on duty. These are the commenter’s premises and questions, not established findings.
records.speaker: Fire-captain CPR question commenter (identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: They see the car. I don't know, obviously, but somebody commented this. They said, in the entire history ... Of fire trucks, how many times has a fire chief, actually fire captain, rode in a fire truck to a hospital ER to perform CPR on a corpse that has been deceased for 15 minutes? Did the hospital have no medical personnel whatsoever on duty?
